stops.title: Di Fɔm dɛn
stops.caption: Siks, fɔ wetin pipul de aks.
stops.speech: Fɔm kɔva fɔs-tɛm vizit, baptizm, tɛstimoni, pikin nem-gi, pikin dedikeshɔn ɛn di Nyu Biliva klas.

stops.title: Ful Wan
stops.caption: I de rich di rayt pɔsin.
stops.speech: Ful wan ɛn i de lan wit udat de andul am, wit di pɔsin link to dɛn rɛkɔd if dɛn dɔn gɛt wan.
